_note: Sample OPERATOR-SIDE evaluation policy override for tools/Invoke-ReviewerEvaluation.ps1 -PolicyFile. It is STRICTER than the shipped default on every axis it touches, which is the only direction that has any effect: ConvertTo-ReviewerEvalEffectivePolicy clamps every cap DOWN to its code ceiling and every floor UP to its code floor, so a permissive value here is silently ignored. Note what is absent: partitionSalt, adjudicationSalt and holdoutPercent belong to the sealed corpus freeze and the harness throws if a policy file even mentions them. This file cannot enable a delivery gate, sign anything, or make suggestions unattended.
